meta.title: Add caching for QME doubling
meta.body_summary: Add preallocated LinearCache objects for QME doubling solver to improve performance by caching linear solutions.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex added caching for QME doubling but PR closed without review or benchmarks after Codecov flagged low patch coverage.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 279 changed lines across 9 files, this is a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume. As a caching performance PR it was closed early without merge, likely due to insufficient evidence and no human validation.

review_details.concern_detail: No human maintainer review or comment was provided; only an automated Codecov coverage report flagged low patch coverage.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve performance of QME doubling by reusing LinearSolve caches.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author 0.6 hours after creation with no human feedback; Codecov showed 3.33% patch coverage.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Requires deep Julia numerical computing knowledge (Quadratic Matrix Equation doubling, LinearSolve caching). Agent lacked evidence of improvement and the PR was closed early.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Codecov provided coverage metrics but no performance validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or before/after metrics; testing section in PR body fails at installation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Author closed PR without addressing missing evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Added QME_caches field of type LinearCache to problem options, preallocates caches for EI and FI systems, and passes them into the doubling solver to reuse linear solutions.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: These files propagate the new cache parameter through function calls and module initialization.
change_trajectory: Initial commit 'Store LinearSolve caches for QME' added cache preallocation and passing to doubling solver.
Follow-up commit 'Improve LinearSolve cache handling' refined cache logic.
PR closed shortly after by author.
